hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: As the sun crept up through the small window, I slowly stirred from my slumber. The candle flickered, casting dancing shadows on the wooden beams. My heart raced as I realized I was not alone. Someone was in the attic, and I could feel their presence by the warmth of the hearth. What secrets did this mysterious visitor have? And what could the dawn hold for me?
caption:
